description: This file defines interfaces and constants for managing flash memory operations on specific microcontroller architectures (e.g., STM32F4XX, STM32F7XX). It includes macro definitions, type declarations, and function prototypes for erasing, reading, writing, and verifying flash memory sectors.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Retrieve the size of a specified flash memory sector.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Get the starting address of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Get the ending address (exclusive) of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determine which sector contains a given address.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erase a span of flash memory starting at a specific address.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Check if a span of flash memory is erased and safe to write.

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compare flash memory content with a buffer to verify data integrity.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Read data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Write data from a buffer into flash memory.
